notes: Versioned system clauses for H3 motion compile. Source of truth for shared headers; PROMPT_FAMILIES hold lane DSL recipes.

clauses.high_motion: HIGH MOTION priority: large visible pose/body change; avoid frozen portrait or micro-breath-only.
clauses.high_motion_timeline: HIGH MOTION priority: large visible pose/body change across the timeline
clauses.soft_motion: SOFT MOTION: micro-performance only (eyes, breath, jaw); locked camera preferred.
clauses.mouth_energy: MOUTH ENERGY priority: clear jaw open-close each Mandarin syllable; visible lip sync; keep face identity fixed; never freeze the mouth
clauses.soft_micro_life: continuous micro-life: never freeze; every half-second a small natural micro-change
clauses.identity_lock: Keep identity and wardrobe fixed; no morphing, no face swap, no extra people.
clauses.style_lock_i2v: Animate the start frame with medium cel-anime style lock. Keep identity and wardrobe fixed.
clauses.style_lock_r2v: Use <Picture 1> as identity and style reference. Keep identity and wardrobe fixed.
clauses.style_lock_flf: First-last-frame image-to-video with medium cel-anime style lock. Animate from the first keyframe toward the last keyframe; land on the last pose and wardrobe; keep identity fixed.
clauses.no_redress: Keep first-frame clothing; never re-dress after undress.
clauses.continue_frame: CONTINUE from this exact end frame; preserve pose, wardrobe, and face identity.
